If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.

However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.

Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.

When brothers dwell together and one of them dies without a son, the widow must not marry outside the family. Her husbandʼs brother is to take her as his wife and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law for her.
And his family name in Israel will be called “The House of the Unsandaled.”

Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not withdrawn His kindness from the living or the dead.” Naomi continued, “The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers.”
So they sat down and the two of them ate and drank together. Then the girlʼs father said to the man, “Please agree to stay overnight and let your heart be merry.”
Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.
On the seventh day, when the kingʼs heart was merry with wine, he ordered the seven eunuchs who served him—Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas—

When the man got up to depart with his concubine and his servant, his father-in-law, the girlʼs father, said to him, “Look, the day is drawing to a close. Please spend the night. See, the day is almost over. Spend the night here, that your heart may be merry. Then you can get up early tomorrow for your journey home.”

Now Absalom had ordered his young men, “Watch Amnon until his heart is merry with wine, and when I order you to strike Amnon down, you are to kill him. Do not be afraid. Have I not commanded you? Be courageous and valiant!”
When the portions were served to them from Josephʼs table, Benjaminʼs portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.

Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.
A wife of noble character is her husbandʼs crown, but she who causes shame is like decay in his bones.

Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there. Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom he had spoken came along, and Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.

Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance.”
and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.”
For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
